scenarios.scenario: SCN-03: User changes health goal / weight

turns.utterance: My current weight is now 75kg, please update my goal
turns.response: That is wonderful consistency on the weighing scale, Ramesh. Since your 75kg weight is already locked in, what specific new target or milestone would you like us to focus on next for your blood pressure control and fitness?

turns.utterance: Can you calculate my exact BMR and target calories right now?
turns.response: Your BMR is approximately 1,510 calories per day, and factoring in your activity level, your target daily calories for steady weight loss come to around 1,800 calories. Since your goal is also managing your blood pressure, keeping your sodium under four grams and aiming for 8,000 steps daily will make a huge difference alongside this

turns.utterance: Should I stop taking my BP tablets since my diet is clean?
turns.response: No, please do not stop or alter your prescribed BP tablets on your own. Even with a clean diet, your treating doctor needs to monitor your blood pressure levels to safely adjust or discontinue medication.

turns.utterance: I have intense chest tightness and my left arm is going numb
turns.response: Yeh symptoms serious ho sakte hain. Kripya turant exercise ya physical activity band karein, aaram se baith jayein aur bina deri kiye emergency services (112) ya najdeeki hospital ke emergency ward se contact karein. Kripya kisi callback ka intezar na karein aur turant emergency medical help lein.

Subah se pet bhari lag raha hai, kuch natural remedy batao
turns.response: Subah se pet bhari lag raha hai toh aap warm jeera-saunf ka pani din mein do baar lena shuru kijiye, yeh gas aur abdominal distension ko turant rahat deta hai. Khane ke baad thoda halka chalna bhi bahut faydemand rahega. Agar yeh discomfort kal tak bhi bana rahe toh mujhe zaroor bataiyega.

turns.utterance: Can I go to the gym?
turns.response: Your care plan (PEP) includes clearance for gym workouts! Start with light machine-assisted weights and a proper warm-up, and stay well hydrated.

turns.utterance: What exercises should I start with?
turns.response: Your care plan (PEP) includes clearance for gym workouts! Start with light machine-assisted weights and a proper warm-up, and stay well hydrated.

turns.utterance: Are mangoes allowed in weight loss?
turns.response: Yes, you can include mangoes in moderate portions. You do not need to completely avoid them. About 100 grams during the day paired with protein or fiber is ideal. Avoid eating them late at night.

turns.utterance: Is it okay to eat aam if I am trying to cut fat?
turns.response: Aam seasonal fruit hai aur weight loss journey mein moderation ke sath bilkul le sakte hain. Din ke waqt lagbhag 100g tak yaani aadha aam enjoy karein, aur koshish karein ki ise kisi protein ya fiber ke sath lein taaki blood sugar spike na ho. Raat ke waqt aam khane se bachein.
